values.note: Individual sites $16 a night for Prince George's and Montgomery County residents, $21 for everyone else; group sites (up to 30 people) $40 / $52.

values.note: 'Reservations must be made online. A Parks Direct account is required to make a reservation.' note: Prince George's County / M-NCPPC (Watkins Regional Park), Upper Marlboro MD. Primitive campground; the park says 'we do not offer RV camping' but 'Class B and Class C camper vans are permitted'. Wooded; the park's pond and creek are away from the campground (not on the water). --Claude
summary: Read pgparks.com's Watkins page and the Parks Direct (WebTrac) site records. Changed derived site count 30 -> 27 (plus 4 group sites); confirmed no hookups, hot showers, online-only reservations. Added fees $16 bi-county / $21 non-county, season March 1 - November 15 (Thursday noon to Monday 11 am only), 4-night maximum within that week and 14 nights per 28 days. Note: dropped the contradicted 'self-contained RVs and trailers explicitly permitted' line, the outdated FCFS text and the RV Life rating line.
flags: Criteria (RV fit): pgparks.com says 'Please note that we do not offer RV camping, and our campsites do not have electricity or RV hook-ups. However, Class B and Class C camper vans are permitted.' (https://www.pgparks.com/parks_trails/watkins-regional-park). EKKO, a Class C, appears to qualify, but trailers and larger RVs do not; no site lengths are published. The old note's claim that 'self-contained RVs and trailers [are] explicitly permitted per the PG Parks camping brochure' is contradicted and was dropped.
Operating days: the campground is open only Thursday noon to Monday 11 am ('closed Monday at 11 am through Wednesday'), so no midweek stays.

Booking restriction looks odd: the WebTrac item for Site #01 also lists 'Disallow Not (Internal Household Status)' and 'Disallow Item begin After 03/02/26' (https://mdpgparksweb.myvscloud.com/webtrac/web/iteminfo.html?Module=RN&FMID=758704), which would block public online booking for the rest of 2026; possibly a season-end setting. Not recorded.
Phone: entry has 301-218-6702, which pgparks.com gives for the Watkins Nature Center; the park's number is 301-218-6700 (https://www.pgparks.com/parks_trails/watkins-regional-park).
